entities.summary: St Peter's Abbey in the Black Forest or St. Peter's Abbey, Schwarzwald is a former Benedictine monastery in the village of St. Peter im Schwarzwald in the district of Breisgau-Hochschwarzwald, Baden-Württemberg, Germany.
